name: How long does a garage conversion ADU take in Los Angeles suburbs?

mainEntity.name: How long does the full garage conversion ADU timeline usually take in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood from design to final inspection?
mainEntity.text: How long does the full garage conversion ADU timeline usually take in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood from design to final inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A realistic schedule should include pre-design feasibility, drawings, engineering, city plan check, permit issuance, construction, and final sign-off. Garage conversions are often faster than new detached ADUs because the shell already exists, but the permit phase can still take weeks or months depending on city workload and how complete the submittal is. Construction time also varies based on whether the garage needs slab repair, new plumbing runs, upgraded electrical service, HVAC, or fire separation work. Projects in tighter urban lots may also slow down because of access limitations and utility coordination. Homeowners should ask for both a best-case and a realistic-case timeline. The best contractors build in cushion for plan corrections and city comments. If the unit must be rentable by a certain date, timeline risk should be addressed before contracts are signed.
